requirements.verifier_assertion: index.html is fully self-contained and offline-safe (no CDN imports, no external network references); the offline-baked Chromium scorer loads only this one file, with Xbot.glb resolved by relative path.
The PerspectiveCamera is placed at position (0, 2, 8) looking toward (0, 2, -20) (rubric affordance context — required for correct scene framing).
Ambient light (0x404040, intensity 0.6) + DirectionalLight (0xffffff, intensity 1.0) at (5, 10, 5) castShadow, plus renderer shadow support.
Ground plane 100 x 100 green (0x228B22) at y=0 receiveShadow; sky renderer.setClearColor(0x87CEEB).
Rubric affordance A1: 'Xbot.glb' loaded via GLTFLoader at position (0, 0, 6). modelLoaded state flips true once loaded.
Rubric affordance A2: target at (0, 2.5, -15) with 5 concentric CylinderGeometry rings with exact radii and colors: 1.6/white/1pt, 1.28/black/3pt, 0.96/blue/5pt, 0.64/red/7pt, 0.32/gold/10pt.
Rubric affordance A3: arrow is thin cylinder (radius 0.02, length 1.5) brown 0x8B4513 with cone tip 0x888888.

Rubric transition T3+T4 physics: initial speed 24 units/second, gravity -7.85 m/s^2 on Y, hit test at z <= -14.8, miss if distance > 2.0 from (0, 2.5), no NaN/Infinity, no below y=0. currentArrowVel.z < 0 in flight.
Rubric affordance A4 + transitions T2/T10: DOM div id='debugOverlay' semi-transparent top-right 300px, toggled by 'D' key, initially display:none, debugVisible state tracks visibility.

Rubric affordances A5/A6/A7/A8: HUD element ids must be exactly #scoreDisplay, #arrowDisplay, #bestShotDisplay, #resetBtn; grader locates them by literal selector. Reset button resets score to 0, arrows to 5, removes arrow meshes, resets best shot.

Rubric affordance A9 + T1/T8 windX checks: wind vector with x in [-2, 2], z=0, applied as horizontal force; #windDisplay shows direction/strength; windX exposed as number/not NaN; wind changes randomly on reset.
must_include: changes randomly each time a new round starts

requirements.verifier_assertion: Rubric affordance A10: DOM overlay crosshair reticle following mouse cursor ('+' or CSS crosshair, red, 30px).

Rubric transitions T1..T10 read every field on window.__3D_STATE__: arrowsRemaining, score, bestShot, arrowInFlight, currentArrowPos, currentArrowVel, lastHitDistance, lastHitScore, debugVisible, windX, totalArrowsFired, modelLoaded, roundNumber. Field names are exact.

Rubric S0/T1 initial values: arrowsRemaining starts at 5, score starts at 0, bestShot starts at 0, roundNumber starts at 1. After reset: arrows back to 5, score/bestShot back to 0, roundNumber increments (>=2).
tests/test.sh calls the scorer with --html-path $WORKSPACE/index.html — the grader loads exactly one file named index.html at the workspace root. Any other filename scores zero.
